samples.content: Good enough fishing waders for the price.GOOD:-Keep me dryish for the most part.-Quick and easy to put on/take off.-Better soles/grip on the boots than I was expecting.-I wear size 14 shoes and these are appropriately sized with a little extra room for thick socks.NOT GOOD:-Wader material not super durable: Made it about a month before I snagged em on some thorns walking through the woods and now have a small leak somewhere between knee and hip on one side but it’s not bad enough to matter in the summer.-The seam where the boots attach to the waders is rough on the inside. Non-issue if youre wearing pants but when wearing shorts it rubbed my shins raw. Got some leggings to wear under my shorts in the summer and it’s fine.-Boot toe has no padding and toe box collapses in water. Gonna hurt if you kick a rock or catch a tree root. If you’re not standing on flat ground your toes are going to jam into the end of the boots which is uncomfortable.

samples.content: I’m 5’5 148lbs size 8, read all the reviews saying get a size up so I got size 9 , threw it on in my kitchen while I was cooking and had oven on so it was pretty warm in my kitchen already and I was only wear shorts on at the time no shirt or socks but was just itching to try it and it feels like the real deal. Definitely nice and sealed up good I was already started to break a sweat or two while wearing it around kitchen to living room for short amount of time but again was cooking so I was already hot. Only reason I gave it a 4 star is because this is definitely made for someone 5inches or more taller than me fits in a way loose but not where I’m stumble to wobble but I’m not complaining nothing really fits me true to size but would be great if it told you ideal height for the wear. But I’d buy it prolly 10 more times even with it being bigger than me jus because of how durable it is , can’t wait to get out in the river fishing trout with this on .
